entities.summary: Mario Pani Darqui was a Mexican architect and urbanist. He was one of the most active urbanists under the Mexican Miracle, and gave form to a good part of the urban appearance of Mexico City, with emblematic buildings, such as the main campus of the UNAM, the Unidad Habitacional Nonoalco-Tlatelolco, the Normal School of Teachers (Mexico), the National Conservatory of Music and other big housing projects called multifamiliares.
